bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Substantial portion of our revenues has been dependent on few customers.
- Further we do not have any long-term commitments from customers and any failure to continue our existing arrangements or loss of any one or more of our major clients would adversely affect our business and results of operations.
- Our reliance on a limited number of customers for our business exposes us to risks, that may include, but are not limited to, reductions, delays or cancellation of orders from our significant customers, a failure to negotiate favourable terms with our key customers or the loss of these customers, all of which would have a material adverse effect on the business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and future prospects of our Company.
- We cannot assure you that we will be able to sell our services as we have historically supplied to such customers.
- In the event our competitors offer better margins to such customers or otherwise incentivize them, there can be no assurance that our customers will continue to place orders with us.
- The loss of one or more of these significant customers or a reduction in the amount of business we obtain from them could have an adverse effect on our business, results of operations, financial condition and cash flows.
- Although our Company maintains long-term relationship with our major customers, there can be no assurance that we will continue to maintain such relationship with our customers.
- Further, our inability to maintain our existing customer network could have a negative impact on our sales, business growth prospects, results in slowdown of operation, financial conditions and cash flows. 2.

compliance_legal.risk: Prospective investors should carefully consider all the information in this Red Herring Prospectus, particularly the “Restated Financial Statement” and the related notes, “Our Business” and “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” beginning on page no 160 & 189 of this Red Herring Prospectus respectively and the risks and uncertainties described below, before making a decision to invest in our Equity Shares.
While we have described the risks and uncertainties that our management believes are material, these risks and uncertainties may not be the only risks and uncertainties we face.
Note: The risk factors as envisaged by the management along with the proposals to address the risk if any.

financial_valuation.risk: Any of the following risks, individually or together, could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations or prospects, which could result in a decline in the value of our Equity Shares and the loss of all or part of your investment in our Equity Shares.
Although the late filing fees levied are small but if we continue this practice, the accumulated amounts of each delay may adversely affect our cash flows.

There are outstanding litigation proceedings involving our Company, our Promoters, an adverse outcome in which, may have an adverse impact on our reputation, business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

internal_operational.risk: Substantial portion of our revenues has been dependent on few customers.

Further we do not have any long-term commitments from customers and any failure to continue our existing arrangements or loss of any one or more of our major clients would adversely affect our business and results of operations.

Our reliance on a limited number of customers for our business exposes us to risks, that may include, but are not limited to, reductions, delays or cancellation of orders from our significant customers, a failure to negotiate favourable terms with our key customers or the loss of these customers, all of which would have a material adverse effect on the business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and future prospects of our Company.

strategy_growth.risk: We currently do not hold any registered Intellectual Property Rights in our name, and this may affect our ability to obtain, maintain, protect, or enforce our intellectual property and other proprietary rights.
There can be no assurance that we will be able to successfully obtain registration against the said trademark application, which may affect our ability to use such trade marks in the future.

If we are unable to renew or register our trademarks for various reasons including our inability to remove objections to any trademark application, or if any of our unregistered trademark are registered in favour of or used by a third party in India or abroad, we may not be able to claim registered ownership of such trademark and consequently, we may not be able to seek remedies for infringement of those trademarks by third parties other than relief against passing off by other entities, causing damage to our business prospects, reputation and goodwill in India and abroad.

concerns_observed: FY26 operating cash flow turned negative at Rs -110.04 lakh despite PAT of Rs 839.81 lakh, driven by trade receivables rising from Rs 202.01 lakh (FY24) to Rs 1,116.15 lakh (FY25) to Rs 1,710.75 lakh (FY26).
Customer concentration remains high: top 10 customers were 69.17% of FY26 revenue (up from 60.12% in FY25, having been 87.09% in FY24); the single largest customer alone was 18.85% of FY26 revenue.

Vendor/supplier concentration has risen sharply: top 10 suppliers were 90.88% of FY26 cost of services versus 33.77% in FY24, an increasing dependence on a small vendor base for an asset-light delivery model.

The largest Objects-of-Issue item - Rs 1,702 lakh for manpower hiring (56 hires spanning CTO/CMO/Solution Architect, R&D, Product, Sales & Marketing, Support and HR roles) - is based on a quotation from Mityung Infotech Private Limited, described in the DRHP itself as an unrelated HR vendor, with no definitive agreement executed.

Promoters' average cost of acquisition is Rs 0.04 per share (Manish Kumar Srivastava, Avinash Kumar Singh and Anupam Kumar Srivastava, each holding roughly 24.9 lakh shares), materially below the proposed Issue Price.

Two bonus issues capitalizing reserves occurred within 18 months of the DRHP: 667 shares for every 10 held (March 22, 2025) and 269 shares for every 100 held (July 16, 2025), affecting comparability of per-share metrics across FY24-FY26.

Objects of the Issue are based on unappraised management estimates - not vetted by any bank, financial institution or independent agency - with no alternate funding source identified for a shortfall in Issue proceeds.
data_gaps: Employee headcount is internally inconsistent across DRHP sections: Objects of the Issue states approximately 100 employees as of June 30, 2026, while the Employee Benefit Expense table reports 127 (FY26), 140 (FY25) and 131 (FY24).
No anchor investor lock-in dates are disclosed in the extracted capital/lock-in section for this issue.

Dilution percentage, total project cost, and the fresh-issue/debt/internal funding-mix figures for Objects of the Issue are not resolved to numeric values in the extracted data (dilution_pct, project.total_cost_lakhs and funding_mix.fresh_issue_lakhs are null).
Market share is not quantified - industry_peers.market_position.share_pct is null, with positioning described only qualitatively as 'niche'/early-mover in ONDC.
monitorables: Promoter Anupam Kumar Srivastava resigned as Whole-Time Director effective December 1, 2025 (retains Promoter/shareholder status); Senior Management Personnel Mohit Srivastava resigned June 28, 2026 - further leadership turnover bears watching.

IT-infrastructure vendor quotations underpinning Rs 675.21 lakh of Net Proceeds are time-bound: Tech Server Infra Private Limited (hardware, valid to November 7, 2026 / August 10, 2026) and Optimus Consultants Private Limited (software, valid 180 days from April 15, 2026) - no orders placed as of the RHP date.
Trademark/logo application (Class 42, Application No. 7206439, filed August 8, 2025) is at 'Formality Check Pass' status, not yet registered.
Group Mediclaim insurance currently covers only 107 employees and does not extend to newly hired staff under the Objects of the Issue manpower plan.
verdict.our_read: ENS Enterprises Limited is an asset-light, ONDC-empanelled IT/digital-commerce services provider whose revenue grew from Rs 1,010.92 lakh (FY24) to Rs 5,137.32 lakh (FY26) at RoNW near 59-62%, even as FY26 operating cash flow turned negative (Rs -110.04 lakh) on a trade-receivables build-up to Rs 1,710.75 lakh while top-10 customer concentration held at 69.17% of revenue.
post_listing_commitments: Minimum Promoters' Contribution of 20.00% of post-issue capital (27,19,000 shares) locked in for 3 years from date of allotment; balance promoter holding of 17.53% locked 2 years and a further 17.53% locked 1 year; all other pre-issue equity locked 1 year per Regulation 239 of SEBI ICDR Regulations.
Brickworks Ratings India Private Limited appointed as Monitoring Agency to oversee deployment of the fresh-issue Net Proceeds across the disclosed Objects of the Issue.

Deployment of Net Proceeds is scheduled within FY2026-27 (manpower hiring August 2026-January 2027; IT infrastructure upgradation August 2026-December 2026; borrowings repayment commencing August 2026), with any unutilized portion carried to FY2027-28.
red_flags: 31 instances of delayed/non-compliant RoC statutory filings (ADT-1, AOC-4, MGT-7/7A, MGT-14, DIR-12, MR-1, ADT-3, PAS-6) spanning FY2016-17 through FY2025-26, with delays ranging from 4 days to 3,447 days (about 9.4 years), per the Secretarial Due Diligence Report dated June 20, 2026.

Experience documents for two of the four Board members - Independent Directors Amita Agarwal and Prince Mishra - are not traceable; their experience is instead evidenced by a Promoter-provided affidavit.

Statutory registrations still reflect the pre-conversion private-limited entity: the EPF Registration Certificate remains in the name 'ENS Enterprises Private Limited', and the ESIC Allotment Letter/Registration Certificate is stated as not traceable.
strengths_observed: Revenue scaled from Rs 1,010.92 lakh (FY24) to Rs 2,833.33 lakh (FY25) to Rs 5,137.32 lakh (FY26) - a 5.1x increase in two years - with EBITDA margin rising from 13.65% to 22.78% and PAT margin from 8.93% to 16.35% over the same period.
Return ratios stayed high and consistent: RoNW/RoE of 62.17% (FY24), 62.01% (FY25) and 58.97% (FY26); RoCE of 84.15%, 84.51% and 78.41% respectively.
Empanelled as a Technology Service Provider (TSP) for the Government of India's ONDC initiative since 2022, positioned by the DRHP as an early mover in this government-backed channel.
Low leverage: total borrowings of only Rs 396.54 lakh, a single Cash Credit facility from ICICI Bank Limited at 9.3%, with zero long-term debt in FY24 and FY25.
None of the Promoters' shares are pledged with any creditor.
Revenue extends across 15 countries beyond India (USA, Singapore, Japan, Canada, England, Europe, etc.), with international revenue at 11.05% of FY26 revenue from operations, up from 9.03% in FY24.
Holds ISO 27001:2022 (information security, certified by MQA Certification Services) and ISO 9001:2015 (quality, certified by Quality Control Certification).
